summary: Our project explores NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars, highlighting its purpose, discoveries and contributions to space exploration through storytelling.
details: It summarizes the report on NASA's leftovers on the Moon and Mars, showing they were left on purpose for science. I made a few slides for demo and details are in pdf.
